en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own situation and get the same cash-versus-mortgage comparison for a home in Cebu
en.runTitle: Dubai to Cebu: a Filipino couple weighing a PHP 4.5 million home, cash or mortgage

fields.label: Income and expenses
fields.value: Combined take-home pay of AED 16,500 a month

fields.label: MP2 maturity
fields.placeholder: e.g. MP2 savings maturing in March 2029

en.template: Compare a Cebu cash purchase with a mortgage using {income}, {savings}, {mp2}, {ceiling} and {returndate}. Protect our reserve, test net AED/PHP savings, and flag Pag-IBIG, SPA and property checks. Ask before contacting anyone, applying, transferring money or sharing personal data.

phases.title: Read official bank, Pag-IBIG and remittance pages
phases.note: Loan terms, transfer fees and rules for buying property remotely
phases.judgment: It would not invent a quote. Exchange-house fees are published (Al Ansari lists AED 23.10 plus VAT), but they are not a personal quote, and no live exchange-rate quote could be obtained without handing over personal data. The guide says so.

phases.title: Write the guide with a 2027–2030 savings plan and a source list
phases.note: Cash purchase against mortgage, transfer cost table, red-flag checklist
phases.judgment: It kept a 5.75% rate from being read as a current offer: the public Pag-IBIG calculator showed it, but that does not establish 2026 promotional pricing. It also found Metrobank’s maximum term for overseas workers is 15 years, not the 25 years in its general advertising.

phases.title: Independent check of every figure and source, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed the figures and found every displayed calculation correct. It still recommended two wording fixes, including showing Metrobank’s income-tax-return condition for loans above PHP 3m, and it noted that not every page was read in a fresh, signed-out browser as required.

workers: Compared the public fees for sending money from the UAE to the Philippines through exchange houses, banks and apps, without asking for personal quotes
Looked up Pag-IBIG housing-loan rules for active overseas members, and kept the 2026 changes apart from the older rates
Checked bank housing-loan terms and paperwork for overseas workers, and found dated bank-owned house-and-lot examples in Cebu
Recomputed every money figure on its own and checked the claims against the source list
